claim_under_examination: ORION turns raw research trajectories into verified reusable methods that causally improve fresh research performance across cycles.
why_this_is_not_a_null_result: A null requires an executed comparison. Nothing was executed here, so nothing may be filed as a null. The lift is blocked upstream, and reporting a blocked lane as a null would be a fabricated negative — as damaging to the record as a fabricated positive.

four_arm_causal_attribution.interpretation_verbatim_from_receipt: The model-dependent four-arm treatment effect is not identified at the registered operating point. This does not negate or establish the structured routing mechanics.

gating_dependency.frozen_subject: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct revision a09a35458c702b33eeacc393d103063234e8bc28, bfloat16, cuda, greedy decoding, 256 max new tokens, LUNARC staged offline weights
gating_dependency.evidence_of_non_execution: no Stage-4 / Stage-5 result receipt exists anywhere under research/; the only model output artifact in the qualification packet is DIAGNOSTIC_RESULTS/qwen2.5-7b-instruct.jsonl, which is Stage-1 development material and is excluded from the fresh panel by the freeze

why_not_executed_in_this_fiber.resource: This lane's compute is restricted to laptop billy, which carries an NVIDIA RTX A3000 Laptop GPU and 22 GB of available system RAM. A 7B model in bfloat16 does not fit that GPU, and the weights are staged on LUNARC, not locally.
why_not_executed_in_this_fiber.protocol: More decisive than the resource limit: the freeze binds device=cuda, precision=bfloat16, a specific transformers version and an exact staged weight path, and registers version_mismatch_terminal = CAPABLE_MODEL_NOT_FEASIBLE_UNDER_RESOURCE_ENVELOPE. Executing the frozen panel under a different runtime would not be the frozen protocol; it would be a silent substitution, which the freeze forbids.
why_not_executed_in_this_fiber.conclusion: Stage 4 must run on the staged LUNARC A100 subject exactly as frozen. It is BLOCKED here, not failed, and not runnable-but-skipped.

instrument_certified_before_budget.controls: an oracle responder that echoes gold passes (so the gate is not mis-specified), and the shipped shortcut audit is clean — all four constant responders (ALWAYS_SUPPORT / ALWAYS_REFUTE / ALWAYS_CANNOT_CHECK / ALWAYS_CONTEXT_MISALIGNED) fail the vector gate
instrument_certified_before_budget.sensitivity: 6 of 7 probes moved the verdict — shuffling verdicts, shuffling selected or rejected evidence IDs, swapping the partition, shuffling task IDs, and making 10% of responses unparseable all flip it to FAIL
instrument_certified_before_budget.the_one_insensitive_probe: corrupting a single verdict does not flip the gate. At n=132 against a 0.85 exact-joint floor that is correct calibration, not deadness, and it is reported rather than hidden.
instrument_certified_before_budget.significance: Unlike the experience-to-action gate, the Stage-4 gate scores model output against panel gold produced by a separate generator, and it can fail. The instrument standing in front of the next confirmatory budget is sound. What is missing is execution, not a working gate.

revival_attempt_before_filing.required_by: the operator's diagnose-revive-before-discard rule — a failure is a lead, not a dead end
revival_attempt_before_filing.attribution_to_one_stage: MODEL_AND_INTERFACE_QUALIFICATION. Not the benchmark (frozen and audited FALSIFIABLE), not the routing mechanics (independently validated), not the analysis.
